brief: Visualize rough-timber and stone-masonry assembly seams on shared proposed full-cell geometry; not component coverage or a completed kit.
sourceReferences: docs/art-templates/player-construction-kit-contract.md — complete architectural material kits; canonical reference frame; required assembly QA

images.review: Six panels show stacking, rotation, corners, T, openings, foundation/wall and roof/wall seam, plus close-up/contact overlay. The study is visually useful, but openings and transitions are not geometry-validated and several roles remain unshown in sufficient detail.
One complete stone-below-timber assembly with direct visible contact seam on a neutral opaque background. Course segmentation and apparent dimensions are illustrative, not calibrated.

rejectedIterations.reason: Unsupported overhanging beam/roof geometry and unaligned assembly parts.

actionableFindings: The concept sheet is a broad visual coverage overview and omits close interface specifics for door/window components, curved transitions, and some roof details.
The clean view presents a simple direct seam; it must not be mistaken for an accepted foundation-to-wall profile, recipe or support result.

coveredVisuallyOnly: rough timber ↔ stone masonry foundation/wall seam
notCoveredOrStillRequired: separately indexed component matrix roles for both kits
detailed jamb/lintel/sill/threshold and door/window interface assets
per-kit assembly studies with documented repeated/stacked/rotated joins, both corners, T, both openings, applicable slope/curve transitions, close-ups and target overlays
